verdict.rationale: telli documents outbound call scheduling: dialing windows, calling strategies and retry behavior, plus an API endpoint that schedules calls within the dialer window with an optional bypass. Batch campaign mechanics and explicit throughput controls are not clearly documented. missing for 10: explicit batch/campaign launch for contact lists, documented throughput or concurrency/rate controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run batch outbound call campaigns with scheduling and throughput controls

citations.quote: Configure dialing windows, calling strategies, and retry behavior.
Schedules a call at the earliest opportunity within the dialer window.
Optional flag to bypass dialing window restrictions for the scheduled call.
Use telli's REST API to programmatically manage contacts, schedule calls, and integrate with your existing systems.
